results.text:
Dario, thank you for engaging on this! I know the Twitter echo chamber is fierce sometimes, so I appreciate you sharing what you believe.

I don’t think the concern about Anthropic’s view that humans will hand over agency to AI is crazy, and I’d love clarification of statements suggesting that:

- In Machines of Loving Grace, you write: “It could be a capitalist economy of AI systems, which then give out resources (huge amounts of them, since the overall economic pie will be gigantic) to humans based on some secondary economy of what the AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans (based on some judgment ultimately derived from human values).”
- Tom Brown on Lightcone: “There’s going to be a handoff where humanity will hand off control to transformative AI at some point” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JdT78t1Offo&t=984s)
